name: aircap
author: jwil007
description: One-click monitor-mode Wi-Fi packet captures from the bar: pick a channel and width, watch the packet count, open the result in Wireshark.

barWidget.description: Monitor-mode Wi-Fi capture. Click: panel · Right: start/stop · Middle: open last capture.

schema.label: Wireless interface
schema.description: Leave empty to use the first wireless interface.

schema.label: Save captures to
schema.description: Folder for .pcapng files (~ is your home).

schema.label: Open in Wireshark when done
schema.description: Default for the panel toggle; the toggle remembers your last choice.

schema.label: Snap length (bytes)
schema.description: Truncate each frame to this many bytes. 0 keeps whole frames.
